name: Yakima Valley Cubing Fall 2018
information:
**Please note: if you want to register for kilominx please comment when you register.  This is an unofficial event for WCA.  Results will show up on cubecomps under a different event the day of the comp but will not upload to the WCA website.**

Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Responsibilities" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.
